result.topic_en: Calculations on a recurrence for coefficients with Gamma-function (Π) products and related Euler integrals, followed by a derivation of the functional equation of the Dirichlet L-function χ(s)=Σ(-1)^n/(2n+1)^s (mod 4 character) via a contour integral and the Gamma duplication and reflection formulas.

$\frac{a^m_n \left(\frac{16\pi i}{9}\right)^n}{\Pi(n-\frac{4}{3}m-\frac{2}{3})\,\Pi(n-\frac{4}{3}m-\frac{1}{3})} = c^m_n$

$= -\pi i\, c^{m-1}_{n-1} \frac{\frac{16\pi i}{9}\,\Pi(n-\frac{4}{3}m)}{\Pi(n-\frac{4}{3}m-\frac{1}{3})}$

$= \sum \frac{(-1)^n}{(2n+1)^s}$
$n^{-s}\,\Pi(s-1) = \int_0^\infty e^{-nx} x^{s-1}\,\partial x$
[-$\Pi(s-1)\chi(s) = \int_0^\infty \sum (-1)^{\frac{m-1}{2}} e^{-(m-1)x}\, e^{-x} x^{s-1}\,\partial x$-]
$\Pi(s-1)\,\chi(s) = \int_0^\infty \frac{e^{-x}}{e^{2x}+1} x^{s-1}\,\partial x$
$\sin\pi s\,\Pi(s-1)\,\chi(s) = -i\int_\infty^\infty \frac{e^{-x}x^{s-1}\,\partial x}{e^{2x}+1} = -\frac{1}{2}\sum\left(\left((m+\tfrac{1}{2})\pi i\right)^{s-1}\tfrac{1}{2}e^{-3(m+\frac{1}{2})\pi i} + \left((m+\tfrac{1}{2})\pi i\right)^{s-1} e^{+(3m+\frac{1}{2})\pi i}\right)\cdot -2\pi i$
$2x = \pm(2m+1)\pi i$ $\quad \frac{1}{2}e^{-3(m+\frac{1}{2})\pi i}$
$\sum (-1)^m (2m+1)^{s-1} \left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)^{s} 4\cos s\frac{\pi}{2}$ $\quad (i^s + i^{-s})\quad -1,\ -i,\ -i\ \ 2$
$\sin\pi(s)\,\Pi(s-1)\,\chi(s) = \left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)^s 4\cos s\frac{\pi}{2}\,\chi(1-s)$
$\frac{(2\pi)^{\frac{1}{2}}}{\sqrt{2}}\,\Pi(s-1) = \Pi(\frac{s-1}{2})\,\Pi(\frac{s}{2}-1)\,2^{s-1}$
$\sin\pi(s)\,\pi^{\frac{1}{2}}\,2^{s-1}\,\Pi(\frac{s-1}{2})\,\Pi(\frac{s}{2}-1)$
$\Pi(\frac{s}{2}-1)\,\Pi(-\frac{s}{2}) = \frac{\pi}{\sin\frac{s}{2}\pi}$
$\Pi(\frac{s-1}{2})\,\chi(s)\,2^{s-1}\pi^{-\frac{1}{2}} = 2\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)^s \chi(s-1)\,\Pi(-\frac{s}{2})\,\frac{1}{\pi}$
$\Pi(\frac{s-1}{2})\,\chi(s)\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)^{-\frac{s}{2}} = \Pi(-\frac{s}{2})\,\chi(s-1)\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)^{\frac{s-1}{2}}$

Solutions of the recurrence as Gamma ratios / Beta integrals
Euler product and Dirichlet series for L-function mod 4
Integral representation of Gamma times L-function
Contour integral evaluated by residues at poles 2x=±(2m+1)πi
Symmetric functional equation of the L-function mod 4
